notes.title: PROTOTYPE Update: Enhanced Animations, Expanded Languages, and Improved Audio
notes.content:
[ GAMEPLAY ]

Introduced new idle animations for the Laser Robot and Close Combat Robot, enhancing the visual appeal and character depth.
Added dynamic new idle animations for Bosses in Level 3 and Level 6, offering a more immersive and engaging player experience.
Implemented visual feedback for taking damage, providing clearer and more immediate player response to in-game actions.
Integrated a new sound effect when picking up powerups, enriching the audio experience and player feedback.
[ LOCALIZATION ]

Expanded language support to include Chinese, Polish, Swedish, Korean, and Japanese, broadening the game's global reach.
Added subtitles and localized UI elements for the newly supported languages, ensuring a more accessible and user-friendly experience for a diverse player base.
[ MISC ]

Fixed timing issues with sound effects in Boss Level 6, ensuring a more synchronized and immersive audio experience.
Enhanced overall game stability and performance through various minor bug fixes and optimizations.
[ AUDIO ]

Refined audio cues and background scores for an enriched auditory experience, complementing the game's visual enhancements.

notes.title: Gameplay Update & Enhancements
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[b]Wall Collision Improvement:[/b] The possibility of getting stuck on a wall during a jump is no longer an issue.
[b]Level 6 Entrance Update:[/b] We've addressed the exploit at the entrance to level 6. Expect to be smoothly redirected into the fight.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Feature Enhancements[/h2]
[b]Narrator Volume Control:[/b] Fine-tune your auditory experience with new individual settings for the narrator.
[b]End-of-Level Sounds:[/b] Embrace the new soundscape with rewarding audio cues at the completion of level 8.
[b]Visual Upgrade on Level 6:[/b] Level 6 now features additional decorations for a visually richer game environment.
[b]New Exploration Paths:[/b] Level 5's side pipes are now explorable, revealing new secrets and surprises.
[b]Crosshair color:[/b] Crosshair color has been changed from black to white to ensure better visibility
[hr][/hr]

[u]Take on the new PROTOTYPE experience[/u] – This update is just the beginning of our continuous efforts to enhance your gaming journey. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940180/PROTOTYPE/]Update Now![/url]

[b]Stay Updated with ColdEnemyGaming[/b]
For more information and future updates, keep an eye on our website:
[url=https://coldenemygaming.de/]ColdEnemyGaming[/url]

We're dedicated to providing you with the best gaming experience. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. We can't wait for you to dive into the updated world of PROTOTYPE. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Patch 16/10/2023
notes.content:
[ GAMEPLAY ]
- Boss Level 6: Fixed a critical issue where players could bypass and finish the level without defeating the boss. Players now need to defeat the boss to proceed.
- Level 5: Resolved a bug where drones remained undestroyed upon collision with the ground, causing players to be trapped indefinitely in the level. Drones will now correctly be destroyed upon impact.

[ ACHIEVEMENTS ]
- Achievement "Truth Seeker": Rectified an issue where the achievement was unavailable for players. It is now attainable once more.

[ USER INTERFACE ]
- Lobby Level 1: Addressed an oversight where the level remained locked for players. It is now unlocked by default for all users.

notes.title: PROTOTYPE Launch: Dive into the Neon Heart of Cyberscape!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Cyberscape explorers![/h2]

Today we're thrilled to unveil an electrifying new addition to the gaming cosmos: PROTOTYPE. Immerse yourself in a neon-drenched digital dimension where battles are fierce, challenges are relentless, and one AI's monumental quest for dominance comes to life.

Enter the arena as 07Vanguard, a unique AI born in the pulsating core of Cyberscape. With a singular, extraordinary purpose, you don't just play, you live the mantra: "Defend. Outmaneuver. Outfight. Outlast." Navigate the maze of challenges, harness the power of neon-lit boosts and blaze your way to victory.

But remember: The Cyberscape rewards the brave. With each wave, the enemies evolve, each battle harder than the last. From the most agile bots to the most powerful bosses, each battle is one step closer to cementing your legacy.

When the dust settles and you're left standing, a resonant question emerges: Is 07Vanguard the quintessential AI warrior? The game may end, but legends? They're immortal.

And because we're just as excited as you are, we're offering a [b]limited-time 25% release discount[/b] on PROTOTYPE. Yes, you read that right! Experience this epic journey for a fraction of the price.

So what are you waiting for? Dive in, take on the challenges and etch your name into the annals of Cyberscape history. With an offer like this, there's never been a better time to join the fray. The arena is set, 07Vanguard awaits, and the neon glow beckons.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940180/PROTOTYPE/]GET YOUR COPY NOW AND TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE 25% DISCOUNT!
[/url]
Charge forth, player. In the world of PROTOTYPE, legends are just a game away.

notes.title: Prepare to Enter the Cyberscape: PROTOTYPE Launching Soon!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Greetings, Operators![/h1][/b]
[h4]
We're thrilled to announce our upcoming game, [b]PROTOTYPE, set to launch on October 16th, 2023[/b]. Embark on a journey into the heart of the neon-lit Cyberscape, where you'll guide 07Vanguard, a unique prototype AI through its trial by fire.

In the neon-lit world of PROTOTYPE, you will guide 07Vanguard, a unique prototype AI, through a harrowing trial in the pulsing heart of the Cyberscape. Your mission is clear: survive the relentless onslaught of menacing robotic adversaries, each wave stronger and more intricate than the last.

Prepare to face the towering Bosses, the formidable titans of steel and silicon. Each boss battle is a test of your skill, strategy, and endurance. Outmaneuver, outfight, and outlast - that's the challenge that awaits you.

You won't be alone, though. Power-ups will materialize around the battlefield, providing you with essential aid in your battle for survival.

[h3]Mark your calendars for [b]October 16th, 2023[/b], when PROTOTYPE launches, and you step into the role of an Operator guiding 07Vanguard. But before that, we have an exciting announcement to make: [b]A playable demo of PROTOTYPE will be available soon![/b] Get ready to dive into the Cyberscape and test your skills ahead of the full game release.[/h3]

Stay tuned for more updates and prepare for an unforgettable journey in the world of PROTOTYPE. The Cyberscape is waiting, Operator. Are you ready for the trial?[/h4]


Best,
Dennis
Head Developer and Founder
Cold Enemy Gaming
